correctness.rationale: A fixed polyhedral vertex is locally Euclidean cone C_alpha. Relative angular measure is exactly 2 min(beta,alpha/2), yielding difference -2alpha r^4 integral J over phi. The radial-angle integration produces J(phi)=[csc^2(phi)+(pi-phi)cos(phi)csc^3(phi)]/8 and integrates to the claimed F(alpha). Locality and compactness isolate finite vertices for small r; normalize ordered area pairs by A^2. Separate antipodal quotient at alpha=pi and seven independent quadrature checks corroborate constants; no extrapolation to large radius.
